risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and identifies specific revenue, margin, restructuring, inventory, and regional pressures, but fiscal 2024 performance deteriorated sharply, including a 6.7% revenue decline and an 86% operating-income decline. Management presents strategic investments and the 9 Story acquisition as catalysts, while relying on forward-looking expectations and estimates amid continued external pressure. Key risks include book-fair economics, education demand weakness, international softness, restructuring costs, and accounting estimates for returns and inventory.
